 This English Pupil’s Book uses research based pedagogy to support pupils to develop
 into successful English language readers. These materials were piloted by the Ministry
 of Education, Science & Technology and USAID during the three year Primary Math
 and Reading Initiative (PRIMR). It focuses on the essential skills for literacy, including
 recognizing letters and their sounds, putting letter sounds together to read words,
 putting words together accurately to make meaning from text, and to write interesting
 stories. The content and skills taught in this English book cover the Kenya Institute of
 Curriculum Development (KICD) syllabus covering the four areas of literacy: listening,
 speaking, reading, and writing, as well as the curricular themes. Among the many
 attributes of this English book are:
 • Exciting practical activities to teach all the themes in the KICD syllabus.
 • Activities that are displayed in a logical order based on research in teaching and
 learning English
 • Colourful illustrations closely related to the stories and pupil’s lives, making learning
 very interesting
 • Interesting, culturally relevant and age appropriate stories for practising and
 improving all skills related to reading
 • Controlled text stories written at pupils’ reading level allowing for independent
 reading and comprehension even in the first weeks of school
 • Teacher read aloud stories to develop oral vocabulary and listening comprehension
 skills
 This book was developed by an experienced technical team from the Ministry of
 Education Science and Technology (MOEST), the Teacher Service Commission (TSC), the
 Kenya Education Management Institute (KEMI), the Kenya Institute of Special Education
 (KISE) and USAID’s Tusome Early Grade Reading Activity.
